subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Freight Brokerage
description: A micro-lesson that makes Freight Brokerage usable.

hook.text: A shipper needs a truck tomorrow. A carrier has an empty one nearby. The broker connects them in minutes.

buildup.text: Freight brokers match shippers who need to move goods with carriers who have available capacity.

discovery.text: They don't own trucks or warehouses. They earn a margin by finding the right carrier at the right price.

twist.text: Digital brokerages are automating what used to require phone calls. Speed wins in the spot market.

climax.text: Brokers handle over 20% of all US truck freight. They're the invisible connectors of supply chains.

punchline.text: Brokers don't move freight. They make freight move.
